overall_summary: Analysis of 32 Shorts shows that planetary/astronomical concepts (Saturn rings, sound in space, atmospheric loss) consistently generate the highest view counts (700 to 1,000+ views) and watch time. Videos with seamless loops and high visual transformation show rewatch rates exceeding 100-190% average view percentage. Early drop-offs occur primarily when hooks rely on abstract seconds-based gravity changes without immediate visual transformations.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' reached 1,038 views with 50.68% average percentage watched and 266 estimated minutes watched.
what_is_working.action: Focus production pipeline heavily on planetary and space interaction scale 'What If' scenarios.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' achieved 195.54% average view percentage with audience watch ratio remaining above 2.7x throughout.
what_is_working.action: Design visual transitions at the end of the Short that seamlessly seamlessly connect back to the opening hook frame.

what_to_improve.pattern: Rapid Hook Drop-offs in Gravity/Time-Gated Shorts
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' lost nearly 90% of viewers by progress 0.10 (watch ratio fell from 1.05 to 0.10).
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate build-up text/intro voiceover; display the dramatic visual transformation within the first 0.5 seconds.

what_to_improve.evidence: Duplicate uploads like 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (published within seconds at 04:55:51Z and 04:56:06Z) split audience traffic.
what_to_improve.action: Ensure scheduling pipeline prevents unintentional double-publishing of the same asset.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' spiked to an audience watch ratio of 6.25 at 49% progress, resulting in 191.21% average percentage watched.
retention_insights.action: Script final sentence to bridge directly into the opening question phrase without an ending CTA.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' dropped audience watch ratio from 1.05 at 1% progress to 0.29 at 25% progress.
retention_insights.action: Replace countdown timers with immediate visual chaos in the first frame to retain curiosity.

best_posting_windows.reason: Top performing uploads ('What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' - 1,038 views, 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' - 706 views) were published between 04:47 and 04:56 UTC.
Secondary peak window delivering top views ('What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' - 880 views, 262 minutes watched).
